name: Back to fight V
author: Waltertheboss
description: Go above the normal gravity portal between the spike and saw at 27% and then enter the UFO portal as reverse gravity and fall onto the slope. Time a click after the slope to go under the cube portal as the UFO and then time one click at 28.8% to get your upper icon to fall to the floor with your lower icon making it so you will fall out of the level after becoming cube at 29%. Free to the end from there.
